title: Queue Service State
description: How one board says something to another. (Runtimes: node; IDs: queue)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

topic.description: The name the two boards agreed on. Required by publish and consume; an optional filter for list

payloadFrom.description: Dotted path to the part of the input to send. Empty sends the whole input

idFrom.description: Where ack and fail find the message id in their input

limit.description: How many messages one consume claims, or list returns

visibilitySeconds.description: How long a claim holds before the message is handed out again

maxAttempts.description: Hand-outs without an ack before the message is left alone

status.description: Filter for list: pending, claimed, done, dead
